name: The Crown
overview: Emmaline Castro, the ambitious COO of a powerful pharmaceutical empire, is stunned when her father chooses her irresponsible brother as the future heir to the company. Determined to prove herself, she sets out to secure a billion-dollar business deal that could change the company’s future. But the key to her success lies with the mysterious investor behind the deal—a man she publicly humiliated years ago. As rivalry, family betrayal, and corporate power struggles intensify, Emmaline must confront her past while navigating an unexpected romance that could alter her future forever.
